name: @pipeworx/mcp-seatgeek

tools.name: events
tools.description: Search SeatGeek events by keyword, venue, performer, location, date range, or category; returns event listings with name, datetime, venue, performers, and ticket URLs.

q.description: Free-text search: performer, team, venue or event name. Put the subject of the question here.

performers.slug.description: SeatGeek performer slug (from the performers tool) — exact, unlike q.

taxonomies.name.description: Category: concert, sports, theater, music_festival, nba, nfl, mlb, nhl ...

datetime_utc.gte.description: Lower bound, e.g. "2026-08-01" or "2026-08-01T00:00:00". Use with .lte for "this month".

tools.name: event
tools.description: Fetch full details for a single SeatGeek event by numeric id, including venue, performers, datetime, ticket counts, and lowest/highest prices.

tools.name: performers
tools.description: Search SeatGeek performers (artists, teams, comedians) by name or genre; returns performer profiles with images, genres, and upcoming event counts.

q.description: Performer, team or artist name, e.g. "Taylor Swift".

tools.name: performer
tools.description: Fetch full SeatGeek performer profile by numeric id, including bio, images, taxonomies, stats, and related performers.

tools.name: performer_by_slug
tools.description: Look up a SeatGeek performer profile by URL slug (e.g. "taylor-swift"); returns the same performer detail as the performer tool.

tools.name: venues
tools.description: Search SeatGeek venues by name, city, state, country, or postal code; returns venue details including address, capacity, and geolocation.

tools.name: venue
tools.description: Fetch full SeatGeek venue record by numeric id, including address, city, state, country, geolocation, capacity, and timezone.

tools.name: taxonomies
tools.description: List all SeatGeek event taxonomies (sports, concerts, theater, etc.) with their IDs and parent/child hierarchy; useful for filtering events by category.

tools.name: recommendations
tools.description: Get ranked SeatGeek event recommendations SIMILAR TO a seed you supply — a performer id, an event id, or the performers of an event. Requires at least one seed; it is not a personalized feed for an anonymous user. Optional filters (geoip, lat/lon, postal_code, datetime_utc, per_page) narrow the result.

performers.id.description: Seed: recommend events similar to this performer id (e.g. 35). Get one from the performers tool.

events.id.description: Seed: recommend events similar to this event id. Get one from the events tool.

events.performers.id.description: Seed: recommend events similar to the performers appearing at this event id.

postal_code.description: Restrict recommendations to a US postal code, e.g. "94002".

lat.description: Latitude to rank recommendations around; pair with lon.

lon.description: Longitude to rank recommendations around; pair with lat.

datetime_utc.gte.description: Only recommend events at or after this UTC datetime, e.g. "2026-09-01T00:00:00".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-seatgeek forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the seatgeek pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
